issues.where: near granulation across the bottom strip, and the same crowns in image-01.png, image-05.png, and image-08.png
issues.what: granule domes carry combed parallel ridges and stretched displacement that read as raked procedural texture at native size
issues.fix: replace the directional displacement with isotropic multi-scale turbulence so cell tops are not raked

issues.where: near and mid photosphere, repeated across image-05.png
issues.what: granules read as glossy plastic or airbrushed wax, with specular crowns and doughy flanks instead of self-luminous plasma
issues.fix: drop the specular sheen; emit from the cell centers and sharpen the lane edges without a varnished highlight

issues.where: the full limb fringe, left to right, and the same edge in image-05.png
issues.what: spicules form a uniform fur or grass groom, with even height, spacing, and thickness
issues.fix: vary length, lean, brightness, and spacing, and soften the tips into the sky

issues.where: grazing granulation just inside the limb
issues.what: lane contrast goes mushy before the limb, beyond ordinary foreshortening
issues.fix: hold lane contrast in the last few degrees and let only the finest scale fade

issues.where: foreground granulation, crops S through W
issues.what: The cells look like smooth, inflated metal cushions. Broad blurred highlights and repeated comb-like creases replace fine surface detail.
issues.fix: Break up the cell shapes and highlight widths, add finer emissive structure across their interiors, and reduce the uniform specular sheen.

issues.where: central dark spot and its rim, crop A
issues.what: The spot is almost featureless black, and long glossy filaments all pinch into the same sharp contour, making it look like a texture pulled into a hole.
issues.fix: Keep faint structure in the dark core and break the rim into irregular, staggered filaments that blend into the surrounding granulation.

issues.where: lower solar disk, crops U and V
issues.what: Bright and dark granules smear into aligned diagonal streaks, losing individual cell detail well before the limb.
issues.fix: Reduce directional blur on the disk and preserve finer granulation through the lower portion while keeping natural foreshortening near the limb.

issues.where: upper and right limb, crops C, G and H
issues.what: A smooth bright outline sits in front of broad, soft radial spokes, so the corona reads as a separate glow layer rather than a continuous transition from the disk.
issues.fix: Vary the rim thickness and brightness, split the broad spokes into finer irregular structures, and blend their roots into the limb.

issues.where: left and right arch footpoints, crops O and Q
issues.what: White cores wash out the contact with the surface, and tight bright-dark speckling just outside the cores makes the transition look cut out.
issues.fix: Roll off the core highlights, filter the finest filament samples, and retain granulation under the footpoint glow.

issues.where: upper-right sky, crops M and N
issues.what: Several bright stars read as soft round blobs against the finer pinpoints.
issues.fix: Tighten the bright star cores while keeping the spread of apparent brightness.

issues.where: sunspots across the disc (crops A, F, G, P, Q)
issues.what: every sunspot is the same dark core with a radial starburst of bright fibrils; the motif repeats 8+ times at similar size and reads as a stamped pattern, not varied umbra/penumbra
issues.fix: vary sunspot size, shape and penumbra structure; cluster them into a few active-region groups instead of evenly scattering one motif

issues.where: photosphere, whole disc (crops A, Q, K, L)
issues.what: surface is a uniform busy swirl of brushy flame strokes at one scale; no granulation cells, no limb darkening of texture detail, reads painterly and over-sharpened
issues.fix: replace with multi-scale granulation plus faculae, reduce local contrast and sharpening, add limb darkening so detail fades toward the edge

issues.where: prominences at upper right and left limb (crops C, D, E, M, O)
issues.what: prominences are smeared painted flame strokes with smudgy red edges and no consistent loop structure or footpoints on the limb
issues.fix: model prominences as coherent plasma loops anchored to the limb with soft emissive falloff and fine filament threads

issues.where: corona all round the disc (crops B, G, K, L, U, V, W)
issues.what: corona is evenly spaced white brush-stroke streaks radiating symmetrically like a starburst filter, too bright and too uniform; stroke texture visible at native size
issues.fix: use streamer/plume structure with uneven density, dimmer and softer falloff, and less regular radial striping

issues.what: limb edge is crisp with a thin bright rim and small sparkle specks hanging below it, giving a cut-out look against the corona
issues.fix: soften the limb transition into the chromosphere and remove the stray specks

issues.where: dark sky, lower left and right (crops J, T, X, W)
issues.what: faint blocky compression grid visible in the near-black sky at native size
issues.fix: add fine dither/grain to the background and export at higher quality to hide block artifacts

issues.where: Milky Way band behind the sun (crops H, I, O, R, S)
issues.what: Milky Way band runs straight through the sun on both sides at the same height, looks like a centered backdrop plate rather than a sky
issues.fix: tilt or offset the galactic band and dim it near the bright corona
